content.value_statement: Cropped images often miss needed canvas for banners, reels, and product layouts. This skill routes outpainting requests to RunComfy edit models through the runcomfy CLI.
actual_capabilities: Selects RunComfy edit routes for simple outpainting, reference-style matching, and brand-specific continuation.
Provides CLI examples for aspect-ratio extension, portrait uncropping, and output directory handling.
Explains when to use Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro, or ComfyUI workflows.
Gives prompt guidance for preserving subjects, lighting, camera distance, and background continuity.
Documents exit codes, token storage, outbound endpoints, and output size boundaries.
limitations: Requires the runcomfy CLI, an authenticated RunComfy account, and network access.
Uses user-provided image URLs, so private images need appropriate hosting controls.
Does not handle mask-driven inpainting or video outpainting.
Dedicated ComfyUI workflows must be opened outside the CLI.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Banners
use_cases.description: Extend a product or portrait image into a horizontal banner while preserving the original subject and lighting.

use_cases.title: Adapt Social Assets
use_cases.description: Convert square assets into vertical or wide formats for feeds, stories, and reels.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Catalog Frames
use_cases.description: Use reference images or alternate routes when a simple extension needs closer style matching.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Canvas Extension
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a wider image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend this image to 16:9. Keep the original subject unchanged. Match the background, lighting, and camera distance. Image URL: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Portrait Uncrop
prompt_templates.scenario: Add missing space below a portrait crop.
prompt_templates.prompt: Uncrop this head-and-shoulders portrait downward. Show more upper body and arms. Preserve the face, pose, clothing style, and existing background. Image URL: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Reference Style Match
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a second image to guide the extension style.
prompt_templates.prompt: Outpaint this image using the reference image for surrounding style. Choose the route that best preserves layout and style. Original URL: [URL]. Reference URL: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Route Recovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan retries when seams or style drift appear.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a multi-step outpaint for this image. Compare Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro, and ComfyUI. Explain when to retry or switch routes. Image URL: [URL].

output_examples.input: A square product photo must become a wide catalog banner.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Nano Banana 2 Edit, asks for a 16:9 extension, and preserves product placement and shadow direction.

output_examples.input: A portrait crop needs more surrounding room for a poster layout.
output_examples.output: The skill frames an uncrop prompt, keeps the visible face unchanged, and extends clothing, background, and lighting downward.

output_examples.input: A historical photo extension needs period-accurate surroundings.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends GPT Image 2 Edit with reference photos or a ComfyUI workflow if seams need precise control.

best_practices: State the target aspect ratio and extension direction at the start of the prompt.
Use image URLs that the user explicitly provided and has permission to process.
Review seams, lighting, and subject preservation before using the final image.
anti_patterns: Do not paste secrets, private tokens, or unrelated data into image prompts.
Do not use arbitrary third-party image URLs without user approval.
Do not expect general edit endpoints to fix pixel-perfect seams every time.

faq.question: Does this skill create images from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It extends an existing still image beyond its current canvas.

faq.question: Which RunComfy model is the default?
faq.answer: It recommends Nano Banana 2 Edit for normal prompt-shaped outpainting.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. It points to GPT Image 2 Edit when style or layout references are needed.

faq.question: Does it support private images?
faq.answer: Yes, if the image URL is reachable and the user accepts external processing by RunComfy.

faq.question: Can it run ComfyUI workflows through the CLI?
faq.answer: No. The skill says dedicated ComfyUI workflows must be opened in RunComfy cloud.

faq.question: What tools does it require?
faq.answer: It requires the runcomfy CLI, RunComfy authentication, and network access to RunComfy endpoints.
